dataset.archive_verification: Dataset command validates split metadata; --verify-archive additionally verifies all archive bytes.

scope_notes: Guard priority chooses representatives during conflict resolution; the final top100 still uses original scores and reserves no whole-image slots.
Each crop is resized to 1024 by 1024. Changing overlap also changes tile size and magnification at a fixed four-tile count.
No camera intrinsics, XYZ backprojection, ground-truth masks, or annotations are supplied to predict_dpseg.

adoption.note: The current default adopts the tested guarded640 strategy. The new CLI and other overlap settings do not inherit new full-val or Kaggle measurements.
